rows.grounds: locative adverb referring to this context

items.question: Is deliberation required after the mental object has been attained in this context?
premises: This attainment occurs in the present context.
Deliberation is negated as something to be done.
items.inference: Once the mental object is attained here, no further deliberation should be undertaken.
uncertainties: The precise referent of 'atra' depends on the preceding ritual instructions.
items.plain_english: The mental object is attained; in this case, no deliberation should be made.
